title: Seven Seas Sailing Center

services.name: Sailing Charters
services.desc: 5 person max: Get ready for a great sail, only $250 for two hours any given afternoon or evening this summer at Buffalo’s Seven Seas Sailing School on Lake Erie. Dust off your blazer, take your ascot to the cleaners, and lace-up those boat shoes, and Bring Your Camera!–because we’re unfurling a deal worth sail-ebrating from Seven Seas Sailing Center.. Bring along your own basket of goodies and wine and you both will step aboard a wind-catching sailing yacht and take in beautiful vistas of the Buffalo skyline and Lake

services.name: Learn to Sail Classes
services.desc: You'll receive a two-hour classroom plus a two-hour dockside lesson. From there you'll have 7-10 two-hour on-water lessons with an instructor and one or two other students. Depending on weather and your confidence reach you should be able to graduate but should require more lessons they are at no charge in our guarantee to graduate
